## Legacy Applicant continuation

Hookbuilder does not accept new Applicant pull requests. New one-off applications must be prepared by the Builder and
submitted as drafts to `0xprogrammable/submit-launch`.

Use this template only to continue Hookbuilder pull request #10, #11, #12, #14, #15, #18, #19, or #20 on its existing
thread. Do not open a new pull request from this template.

- [ ] This update belongs to one of the eight listed legacy pull requests.
- [ ] It updates only that pull request's existing Applicant record for one exact public source revision.
- [ ] The source repository ID, commit, root tree, permissions, fee terms, and public launch-wallet declaration are exact.
- [ ] The change contains no private key, seed phrase, credential, wallet session, private source, or personal data.
- [ ] I understand that this requests review only and does not approve, deploy, sign, route, or launch the project.
